presidio.configuration: Source-described Italian spaCy pipeline and structured recognizers; seven-category deny-by-default policy. Runtime image ID and HTTP policy version are recorded per run.

PERSON.scope: Contextual human names; not bare ambiguous words or organizations/places.

EMAIL_ADDRESS.scope: Syntactically valid email addresses; annotate target overlaps even inside excluded-category distractors.

PHONE_NUMBER.scope: Any country with explicit + or 00 prefix; national numbers default to IT; metadata-valid whole envelope only, no valid substring salvaged from malformed, long or Unicode-adjacent envelopes.

IT_FISCAL_CODE.scope: Canonical 16-character Italian fiscal code with checksum and whole-token boundaries; omocodia out of scope.
IT_FISCAL_CODE.checksum: required by the category contract; see source evidence

IT_VAT_CODE.scope: 11 digits with checksum, compact optional IT prefix; all-zero is negative; whole-token boundaries.
IT_VAT_CODE.checksum: required by the category contract; see source evidence

IBAN_CODE.scope: Italian 27-character IBAN, mod97 valid; ASCII spaces allowed; whole-token boundaries; domestic CIN and assignment not verified.
IBAN_CODE.checksum: required by the category contract; see source evidence

CREDIT_CARD.scope: 13–19 ASCII digits passing Luhn, ASCII spaces/hyphens allowed; whole envelope; no issuer or assignment claim.
CREDIT_CARD.checksum: required by the category contract; see source evidence
